title: Mass impact real one
author: Virendra nath
desc: All u need to gain muscle

ex.note: 4 sets Focus on protracting and retracting the scapula. A slight twist of the hips to get a bigger stretch/contraction is OK, but control the weight. Keep these strict.
2-3 sets Pretty standard stuff here, just make sure to control the eccentric. Attempt to bring chest to bar (or bar to chest) but if you don't quite get it the last few reps, don't worry. TRY though

Trap bar is ideal here, but you can use a barbell or even dumbbells if you want. Just don't destroy any barbells in a rack or anything like that. Keep these fairly strict,
Big stretch and contraction
sets with pause in the bottom for 1 full second (count to 2) Grind these out. Last reps should be slow and effortful. That means FULL of effort
2-3 sets Strict form, nice squeeze and contraction with fairly straight arms. Step back slightly so that you're getting a nice stretch on the upper back and rear delts here.
3-4 sets Incline the bench back slightly, about 75 degrees or so. Keep the weight close, don't hit yourself in the chin but you shouldn't be far away from it.
2-3 sets Take to 0 RIR (until you get a grindy rep) Do these with a rope or bar, leaning away from the stack, with the attachment high. Twist it down around each set
2 second pause at the bottom
2-3 sets Take to 1-2 RIR Start light here if you've never done these. Control the entire eccentric, from top to bottom. Keep your ribs down, don't flare them or lean back excessively.

Pause in the bottom position 3 seconds
knees fairly forward and quite upright. Squat as deep as you comfortably can, at least to parallel(ish

Lengthened partials, going from knee to floor only. Stay braced! These will be tough, you should be able to use MUCH more weight weeks 5-8 and 9-12
Focus on technique for the heavy set
1.5 reps (lunge forward, come slightly up, back down, then stand up and forward.. If these aren't getting you sore and you feel like you're recovering well, do a third
5 min total work
Drive your chest up here along with the elbows down, control the eccentric here as well. If you're doing pulldowns week 9-12 just stick with 6-8 reps, 4-6 is probably too heavy.
Bit of momentum is OK here, just don't flail around, you're not a medieval bludgeoning weapon. Let your scapula protract/retract, that's how you build thickness. Keep your core braced though.
2-3 sets Keep strict form and go to failure
Keep it in the bottom part of the range of motion, going up until you feel the resistance drop off, and go until failure.
2-3 sets 30-60 seconds per set Use straps if you can. Let your shoulders hang down and your traps stretch out. Internally rotating your arms helps with this for many people.
Get a nice stretch here but no bonus points for contortionism especially if it limits the weight significantly. 0 RIR here
Push these hard, no need to fail but have them genuinely be 0 RIR or very close.
RIR on both sets (go until a grindy rep) • Do these standing, with the attachment about halfway down so you can just quarter squat down and grab it. I suggest a V-bar
Full range of motion here, getting a nice stretch and contraction. Can put the attachment lower so you can have a fairly even feeling of resistance.
